             <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg col-xl-auto ms-lg-5 ms-xl-0 me-xl-4" style="max-width: 490px;">
                 <h2 class="fs-0 font2-color">Accommodation</h2>
                 <h3 class="font-poppins  font2-color fs-2 mb-4 pb-3 col-lg-12 fw-normal">A natural escape by the lagoon and the sea</h3>
                 <div class="font2-color mb-4 pb-4 mb-md-0 pb-md-0"><p data-start="436" data-end="616">Tucked between tropical gardens and peaceful lagoons, Kitesurfing Lanka offers accommodations in Kalpitiya, Sri Lanka that combine nature, comfort, and a strong sense of place.</p>
<p data-start="618" data-end="669">Not a hotel. Not a resort. A shared experience.</p>
<p data-start="671" data-end="827">From beachfront bungalows to garden stays and glamping tents, everything is built into the landscape of a former coconut estate — just steps from the water.</p>
<p data-start="829" data-end="959">Consistently ranked #1 on TripAdvisor in Kalpitiya, KSL is trusted by travelers looking for a stay that goes beyond the usual.</p>
</div>

                     <h2 class="fs-0">Your Stay</h2>
                     <h3 class="fs-2  font1-color font-poppins fw-normal col-md-10 col-lg-8">Best Accommodation in Kalpitiya</h3>
                 </div>
                 <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-auto mt-lg-5 pt-lg-4 font1-color" style="max-width: 510px;"><p data-start="1082" data-end="1208">From budget-friendly options to private villas, our accommodations in Kalpitiya are designed to match different travel styles.</p>
<p data-start="1210" data-end="1319">Whether you’re traveling solo, as a couple, with friends, or as a group — there’s a setup that works for you.</p>
<p data-start="1321" data-end="1379">All stays are designed to keep things simple and seamless.</p>
<p data-start="1381" data-end="1401"><strong data-start="1381" data-end="1401">What’s included:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="1403" data-end="1592">
<li data-start="1403" data-end="1444">Full board (breakfast, lunch, dinner)</li>
<li data-start="1445" data-end="1461">Gear storage</li>
<li data-start="1462" data-end="1506">Access to the kite spot in front of camp</li>
<li data-start="1507" data-end="1555">Transport to Kalpitiya Big Lagoon (seasonal)</li>
<li data-start="1556" data-end="1592">Access to all on-site facilities</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1594" data-end="1713">Everything is within walking distance — from your room to the water, the restaurant, and the social spaces around camp.</p>

 <section class="container-fluid" style="padding-bottom: clamp(70px, 7vw, 100px);padding-top: clamp(70px, 7vw, 100px); ">
     <div class="container-fluid" style="max-width: 1240px;">
         <div class="row justify-content-between align-items-center gy-4">
             <div class="col-12 col-md-6 ms-xl-5 ps-lg-5 " style="max-width: 450px;">
                 <h2 class="fs-0 font2-color">Art &amp; Nature</h2>
                 <h3 class="font-poppins  font2-color fs-2 mb-4 pb-3 col-md-11 col-xl-12  fw-normal">More than a place to stay in Kalpitiya</h3>
                 <div class="font2-color">
                     <p data-start="474" data-end="573">At Kitesurfing Lanka, nature and creativity aren’t added features — they’re part of the foundation.</p>
<p data-start="575" data-end="827">What started as a simple kite camp has grown into a space shaped by plants, people, and ideas. Over the years, Dil has transformed the property into a living landscape, inspired by Sri Lankan artists and visionaries like Bevis Bawa and Laki Senanayaka.</p>
<p data-start="829" data-end="1016">Their influence can still be felt across the camp — not in a polished or curated way, but in something more organic. A place where art, community, and environment naturally come together.</p>
<p data-start="1018" data-end="1058">You’ll notice it without looking for it:</p>
<ul data-start="1060" data-end="1217">
<li data-start="1060" data-end="1095">Sculptures hidden between trees</li>
<li data-start="1096" data-end="1140">Open spaces that invite you to slow down</li>
<li data-start="1141" data-end="1217">Corners that feel made for conversations, ideas, or doing nothing at all</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1219" data-end="1334">This isn’t just accommodation in Kalpitiya.<br data-start="1262" data-end="1265" />It’s a space that evolves — shaped by the people who pass through it.</p>
<p data-start="1336" data-end="1406">Come for the wind. Stay for the vibe.<br data-start="1458" data-end="1461" />And discover everything in between.</p>
                 </div>

        <div class="accordion" id="accordionAll">
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading1">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse1"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse1">
                        1. Where should I stay in Kalpitiya for kitesurfing?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse1"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading1"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Kitesurfing Lanka sits on an 8-acre beachfront property in Kalpitiya with direct access to our flat-water spot—perfect for wing foiling year-round and kitesurfing during the winter season. In the summer, we chase the best wind with daily shuttles to the main Kalpitiya Lagoon and regular Kitesurfaris to legendary spots like Dream Spot and Navy Point. Plus, we are the only school with exclusive overnight infrastructure on Vella Island, letting you stay on Sri Lanka's ultimate flat-water paradise long after the day-trippers have left. This makes us the most convenient and diverse base whether you're learning for the first time or progressing your skills.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading2">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse2"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse2">
                        2. What are the best kitesurf camps with accommodation in Sri Lanka?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse2"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading2"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Kalpitiya is home to Sri Lanka's main kitesurfing camps, most combining accommodation with lessons, gear storage and full board meals in one package. Kitesurfing Lanka offers this all-in-one setup across a range of room types, from budget glamping tents to private luxury beachfront bungalows, so you can choose a style that suits your trip without sacrificing easy access to the water.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading3">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse3"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse3">
                        3. What accommodation options are available for kitesurfers in Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse3"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading3"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Kalpitiya accommodation for kitesurfers typically ranges from shared glamping tents to private bungalows and villas. At Kitesurfing Lanka, options include budget-friendly glamping, beach bungalows with sea views, premium bungalows with air conditioning and private terraces, lagoon-view and garden-view bungalows, and one larger villa suited to families or groups.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading4">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse4"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse4">
                        4. Glamping vs bungalow in Kalpitiya - which is better?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse4"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading4"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        It comes down to budget and privacy. Glamping tents are the more affordable option, offering elevated mattresses and shared bathroom facilities under a thatched roof, ideal for backpackers and solo travellers who want to keep costs down. Bungalows offer more privacy with private bathrooms, and in premium options, air conditioning and sea or lagoon views, making them better suited to couples or those wanting extra comfort after a day on the water.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading5">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse5"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse5">
                        5. What&#039;s included in a kitesurf camp stay?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse5"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading5"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Most kitesurf camp stays in Kalpitiya include full board meals, gear storage, and access to the kite spot directly in front of the property. At Kitesurfing Lanka, this also extends to seasonal transport to the Kalpitiya Big Lagoon and access to on-site facilities such as the restaurant, bar and activity areas, so guests have everything they need included in the one stay.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading6">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse6"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse6">
                        6. Are there family-friendly kitesurfing resorts in Sri Lanka?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse6"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading6"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Yes, several kitesurf resorts in Kalpitiya cater specifically to families and groups. Kitesurfing Lanka offers dedicated family and group accommodation, including one two-floor villa with private kitchen and shared bungalow options, allowing families or larger groups of friends to stay together on the same property while still being close to the kite spot.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading7">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse7"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse7">
                        7. Should I choose a budget or luxury stay in Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse7"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading7"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Both are well catered for. Budget travellers can opt for glamping tents that keep the essentials covered without the extra cost, while those wanting a more indulgent stay can choose premium or luxury bungalows with private terraces, air conditioning and enclosed bathrooms. Many camps, including Kitesurfing Lanka, offer both ends of the scale on the same property, so travel companions with different budgets can stay together.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading8">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse8"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse8">
                        8. What does a full board kitesurf holiday in Sri Lanka include?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse8"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading8"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        At Kitesurfing Lanka, full board stays include three daily meals served buffet-style in our restaurant. You can choose to eat together at our famous "Big Table" to connect with the community, or sit at one of the smaller tables if you prefer a more private meal. Our buffet offers a delicious fusion of Sri Lankan and international cuisine, and we easily cater to all dietary needs, including vegetarian, vegan, and Ayurvedic options. You can also easily add lessons, wing foiling, or diving to round out your holiday.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading9">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse9"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse9">
                        9. How do I book kitesurf accommodation in Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse9"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading9"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Kitesurf accommodation in Kalpitiya can be booked directly through the camp's website, where you can view room types, check rates and select add-ons such as lessons or excursions. Booking directly with Kitesurfing Lanka also allows you to combine your stay with kite or wing foil packages for a more complete holiday.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading10">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse10"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse10">
                        10. How do I book a bungalow at Kitesurfing Lanka?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse10"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading10"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Bungalows at Kitesurfing Lanka can be booked through the accommodation pages on the website, where each room type - including Beach, Premium, Lagoon View and Garden View bungalows - is listed with its own features. Selecting a bungalow also secures full board, gear storage and kite spot access as part of the stay.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading11">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse11"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse11">
                        11. Can I book a beachfront villa in Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse11"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading11"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Yes, beachfront bungalows are available in Kalpitiya for travellers wanting more space and privacy, particularly families or groups.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading12">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse12"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse12">
                        12. Are there kitesurf and stay packages in Sri Lanka? 
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse12"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading12"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Yes, most kitesurf camps in Sri Lanka bundle accommodation together with lessons and equipment as part of a single package. Kitesurfing Lanka offers combined packages for beginners learning to kite, those progressing their skills with coaching, and wing foilers, each pairing a set stay length with lessons and full board.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading13">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse13"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse13">
                        13. What does an all-inclusive kitesurfing holiday in Kalpitiya include?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse13"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading13"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        An all-inclusive kitesurfing holiday generally covers accommodation, full board meals, gear storage, kite spot access and a set number of lessons or coaching sessions. Kitesurfing Lanka's packages follow this format, with options tailored to different goals, from learning to kite for the first time to refining tricks with dedicated coaching.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading14">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse14"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse14">
                        14. Are there current deals on kitesurf resorts in Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse14"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading14"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Kitesurf resorts in Kalpitiya often run seasonal packages that combine a set stay length with lessons at a reduced rate compared to booking separately. Kitesurfing Lanka's current deals include options for beginners, wing foilers and divers, each bundling accommodation with the relevant coaching for a set number of nights.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading15">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse15"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse15">
                        15. What are the room rates at Kitesurfing Lanka?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse15"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading15"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Room rates vary by accommodation type, from the more affordable glamping tents through to premium and lagoon-view bungalows and the private villa, with full board, gear storage and kite spot access included across all room types. Exact rates depend on room selection and season, so checking current pricing directly on the "How Much?" is the best way to confirm costs for your dates.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading16">
                    <button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
                        data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                        data-bs-target="#collapse16"
                        aria-expanded="false"
                        aria-controls="collapse16">
                        16. Is group accommodation available for kitesurfing trips to Kalpitiya?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse16"
                    class="accordion-collapse collapse"
                    aria-labelledby="heading16"
                    data-bs-parent="#accordionAll">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        Yes, group accommodation is a common option at Kalpitiya's kitesurf camps for friends or larger groups travelling together. Kitesurfing Lanka offers a shared villa and bungalow options designed for groups, allowing everyone to stay on the same property with shared access to the kite spot and on-site facilities.                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
